meta.split: held out when sha1(id)[0] < 0x33 (GKM429), fixed before the label passes ran
meta.foldRule: A class map folds into ledger notes only if, on its stated-class rows, at least 5 agree with the map and the count exceeds the majority baseline; otherwise the labels stay in the sidecar as model tier, unchecked. A rank, grade or level is a stated field, never a score.

slugs.mind-binding: a power that binds or rewrites another mind (shared slug, PWC5)
slugs.time-loop: the holder returns to an earlier time or state with memory; src/anchor_snapshots.js branches a world at anchors but restores no body on death (shared slug, PWC5)
slugs.area-field: an effect that holds over an area and not a target (shared slug, PWC5)
slugs.power-interaction: a power that answers, cancels or counters another power (shared slug, PWC5)
slugs.form-transformation: the holder changes own body or form (census slug)
slugs.familiar-summon: bound spirits, shadows or summoned servants that act on their own (census slug)
slugs.power-transfer: the power passes by death, theft, inheritance or gift (census slug)
slugs.vow-cost: a binding oath, contract or price that pays for the power (census slug)
slugs.item-bound-power: the power lives in a held object that can be lost, stolen or broken (census slug)
slugs.sponsorship-contract: a patron grants, sets terms on and can withdraw the power, paid in coins or stories; no patron relation exists in the engine (new slug, ORV)
